title: Pigment, a French startup that makes AI-powered software to help businesses forecast finances, spin up slide decks, and more, raised $250M at a $2.3B valuation (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
summary: Dina Bass / Bloomberg: Pigment, a French startup that makes AI-powered software to help businesses forecast finances, spin up slide decks, and more, raised $250M at a $2.3B valuation — Pigment, a French AI company that competes with Microsoft's Excel and PowerPoint, has raised $250 million in a funding round …
